description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Notify the Market Rate of Interest for the Purpose of Debt  Recovery (Special Provisions) Act.
categorisation: This gazette content is a notification issued by the Central Bank of Sri Lanka under Section 30 of the Debt Recovery (Special Provisions) Act, No. 02 of 1990. It establishes a new regulatory requirement (the Market Rate of Interest) and is published by authority. This fits the definition of Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) as it pertains to regulatory frameworks, compliance requirements, and statutory instruments.
